retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style cosmic collage featuring airbrushed nebulae, ringed planets, and marquee-style typography with integrated human figures in futuristic attire.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, multi-layered cosmic scene characterized by a deep black starfield, vibrant red and pink nebulae, and multiple ringed planets. The composition uses a central spherical focal point containing a group of figures, topped with stylized, illuminated typography that follows the curvature of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched marquee text framing the top edge
Central planet acting as a vessel for human subjects
Diagonal planetary rings creating depth and movement
Contrast between deep space black and saturated nebula reds
coreInvariants: Grainy, airbrushed texture across all gradients
Starfield composed of varied dot sizes and lens flares
Planetary rings with soft, glowing edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five figures in the lower-middle foreground, housed within a large translucent planet.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central planet with glowing rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the arched text at the top, drop to the central logo, and then follow the diagonal rings through the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black starfield in the upper corners and bottom edges provides breathing room for the dense central collage.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Glowing White and Pale Yellow (Stars and Highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the nebulae and planets contrasted against a low-value, dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm reds, oranges, and earthy browns for planets

letterConstructionRules: Arched text uses marquee-style dots inside letterforms
Central logo uses multi-line inline strokes
Secondary text uses wide, blocky proportions with soft glows
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '21st' is rendered as a large, multi-line graphic icon
Top arch letters contain internal circular 'lightbulb' patterns
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine a marquee-style arched header with a heavy, multi-line geometric logo and wide-set sans-serif subtext.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 'Ahead of Our Time' dotted aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s airbrushed space scene with a central red planet, glowing diagonal rings, and a dense starfield with red nebulae. Leave the top 20% clear for arched text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply arched marquee-style lettering along the top curve and a multi-line geometric logo in the center-top, using a soft outer glow.

verificationChecks: Does the text follow a perfect arc?
Is the texture grainy and airbrushed rather than smooth?
Are the planetary rings glowing and translucent?
Is the color palette dominated by red, black, and white?

mustRedesign: Avoid literal recreation of specific faces
Do not use modern 3D planet textures
Ensure typography is not a standard system font

avoid: Pure white without a warm tint

postGenerationChecks: Verify the marquee dots are visible in the top text
Ensure the central planet feels like a container
Confirm the planetary rings have a soft, feathered edge
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Space Nebula Background] + [Airbrushed Ringed Planets] + [Arched Marquee Typography] + [Multi-line Geometric Logo] + [Grainy Analog Texture].
